The Jacobi update formulas for a $3 \times 3$ matrix are given below.

$$
\begin{align}
x_1^{(k+1)} &= \frac{1}{A_{11}}\left( b_1 - A _{12} x_2^{(k)} - A_{13} x_3^{(k)}  \right) \\
x_2^{(k+1)}  &= \frac{1}{A_{22}}\left( b_2 - A _{21} x_1^{(k)}  - A_{23} x_3^{(k)}  \right) \\
x_3^{(k+1)}  &= \frac{1}{A_{33}}\left( b_3 - A _{31} x_1^{(k)}  - A_{32} x_2^{(k)}  \right) 
\end{align}
$$

### System 1:

Find $\mathbf{x}^{(1)}$, $\mathbf{x}^{(2)}$ and $\mathbf{x}^{(3)}$ by successive application of the update formulas.

$$
A = \begin{bmatrix} 4 & 1 & 2 \\
-\cfrac{1}{2} & 3 & \cfrac{3}{2} \\
0 & 2 & 4 
\end{bmatrix}, \quad b = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}, \quad \mathbf{x}^{(0)} = \begin{bmatrix} x_1^{(0)} \\ x_2^{(0)} \\ x_3^{(0)} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}
$$

\vspace{1in}

After 01 Jacobi iteration, $\displaystyle \mathbf{x}^{(1)} = \begin{bmatrix} x_1^{(1)} \\ x_2^{(1)} \\ x_3^{(1)} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \phantom{x_1^{(0)}+10} \\ \phantom{x_2^{(0)}} \\ \phantom{x_1^{(0)}} \end{bmatrix}$

\vspace{1in}

After 2 Jacobi iterations, $\displaystyle \mathbf{x}^{(2)} = \begin{bmatrix} x_1^{(2)} \\ x_2^{(2)} \\ x_3^{(2)} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \phantom{x_1^{(0)}} \\ \phantom{x_2^{(0)}+10} \\ \phantom{x_1^{(0)}} \end{bmatrix}$

\vspace{1in}

After 3 Jacobi iterations, $\displaystyle \mathbf{x}^{(3)} = \begin{bmatrix} x_1^{(3)} \\ x_2^{(3)} \\ x_3^{(3)} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \phantom{x_1^{(0)}} \\ \phantom{x_2^{(0)}+10} \\ \phantom{x_1^{(0)}} \end{bmatrix}$

{{< pagebreak >}}

The Jacobi update formulas for a $3 \times 3$ matrix are given below.

$$
\begin{align}
x_1^{(k+1)} &= \frac{1}{A_{11}}\left( b_1 - A _{12} x_2^{(k)} - A_{13} x_3^{(k)}  \right) \\
x_2^{(k+1)}  &= \frac{1}{A_{22}}\left( b_2 - A _{21} x_1^{(k)}  - A_{23} x_3^{(k)}  \right) \\
x_3^{(k+1)}  &= \frac{1}{A_{33}}\left( b_3 - A _{31} x_1^{(k)}  - A_{32} x_2^{(k)}  \right) 
\end{align}
$$

### System 2:

Find $\mathbf{x}^{(1)}$, $\mathbf{x}^{(2)}$ and $\mathbf{x}^{(3)}$ by successive application of the update formulas.

$$
A = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & 3 & 2 \\
4 & 5/2 & -1 \\
0 & 3 & 1 
\end{bmatrix}, \quad b = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 2 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}, \quad \mathbf{x}^{(0)} = \begin{bmatrix} x_1^{(0)} \\ x_2^{(0)} \\ x_3^{(0)} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}
$$

\vspace{1in}

After 01 Jacobi iteration, $\displaystyle \mathbf{x}^{(1)} = \begin{bmatrix} x_1^{(1)} \\ x_2^{(1)} \\ x_3^{(1)} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \phantom{x_1^{(0)}+10} \\ \phantom{x_2^{(0)}} \\ \phantom{x_1^{(0)}} \end{bmatrix}$

\vspace{1in}

After 2 Jacobi iterations, $\displaystyle \mathbf{x}^{(2)} = \begin{bmatrix} x_1^{(2)} \\ x_2^{(2)} \\ x_3^{(2)} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \phantom{x_1^{(0)}} \\ \phantom{x_2^{(0)}+10} \\ \phantom{x_1^{(0)}} \end{bmatrix}$

\vspace{1in}

After 3 Jacobi iterations, $\displaystyle \mathbf{x}^{(3)} = \begin{bmatrix} x_1^{(3)} \\ x_2^{(3)} \\ x_3^{(3)} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \phantom{x_1^{(0)}} \\ \phantom{x_2^{(0)}+10} \\ \phantom{x_1^{(0)}} \end{bmatrix}$
